lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 105010112 · After Let's Beat Marin chat 2. Milk!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: turns out the name you chose for this group was rather prescient.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: We defeated Marin!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Quite easily, as a matter of fact.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: I knew you could do it, Milk!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: I believed in you all the way!
Great job, everyone.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Pal, Clay.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: I wanted to thank you both for taking the time

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: to walk me through everything.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Actually, that reminds me.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Are you gonna come watch, Pal?
Watch what?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: The competition that Rewind's gonna be a part of.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: I got invited too.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Why don't we go together?
Sure.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Oh my goodness! You guys have no idea

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: how happy it makes me to hear that both of you are coming!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Thank you for taking time away from your busy schedules.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: We're going in with awfully high expectations,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: so we're expecting one heck of a show,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: aren't we, Pal?
Oh yes, we're very much looking forward to it.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: You know that I'll do my best,

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: but when you put it that way,

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: it does feel like a lot of pressure...

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: However!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: You felt this way before, and you were able to overcome it, weren't you, Milk?

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: I'll just think of you and Coach

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: and give it my all.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Sounds good!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: See you there.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Good luck.
You've got this, Clay.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Thanks, guys!
